method: For each exact pinned source, rerun native source admission at the already-established fine diagnostic grid. The baseline is unchanged. Each counterfactual changes one observed SVG feature in both the admitted input and expected render, so a baseline refusal followed by counterfactual admission isolates the mismatch mechanism for that example. A counterfactual is diagnostic and is not a semantics-preserving repair of the original source.

viewBoxAssessment: A real normalization must parse min-x, min-y, width and height, then reproduce SVG viewport and preserveAspectRatio semantics on every geometry coordinate. For beehiiv's 0 0 24 25 into a square render, default xMidYMid meet implies a uniform 24/25 scale and horizontal centering, including stroke scaling. Merely rewriting viewBox, independently scaling x/y, or scaling paths while leaving stroke width unchanged would alter the source. Existing flat parsing also refuses transforms; broad SVG support is outside this probe.
scope: Offline diagnostic only. No provider, production source, threshold, grid, stored source SVG, plan or foundry log was changed.
